requirement_title: As a customer, I want to browse available mobile devices, review the product details and configuration, and proceed through the purchase journey, so that I can successfully purchase a mobile device online.

traceability_matrix.acceptance_criterion: AC1 – Mobile Device Listing: The customer shall be able to: Navigate from the StarHub Home page to Mobile → All Phones. View the Mobile Devices listing page. Verify that the page heading is displayed correctly. Verify that the correct URL is loaded. View all available mobile devices.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can successfully navigate to Mobile Devices listing page from StarHub personal homepage
Verify successful navigation to All Phones listing page from StarHub homepage
traceability_matrix.reason: Test cases 656 and 666 comprehensively validate AC1 by verifying navigation from StarHub homepage to Mobile → All Phones, confirming page heading 'Mobile Devices', validating correct URL pattern, verifying device count display, and ensuring all available mobile devices are visible on the listing page.

traceability_matrix.acceptance_criterion: AC2 – Product Details Page: The customer shall be able to: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from the device listing. Navigate to the Product Details Page. Verify the product information. Verify the Product Details Page URL.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device from All Phones listing and navigate to device details page
Verify Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device details page displays when selected from All Phones listing
traceability_matrix.reason: Test cases 657 and 667 fully validate AC2 by verifying the ability to locate and select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from the device listing, navigate to the Product Details Page, verify product information display, and confirm the correct PDP URL pattern.

traceability_matrix.acceptance_criterion: AC3 – Default Device Configuration: When the Product Details Page is opened, the application shall: Display the default device colour. Display the default storage option. Display the default payment option. Display the correct pricing for the default configuration.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify default device configuration displays correct values for Colour, Storage, and Payment option on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G details page
Verify default device configuration displays correct colour, storage, and payment option on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP
traceability_matrix.reason: Test cases 658 and 668 comprehensively validate AC3 by verifying that default device colour (Awesome Navy/Black), default storage (256GB), default payment option (24-month installment), and correct pricing are displayed when the Product Details Page loads.

traceability_matrix.acceptance_criterion: AC4 – Purchase Journey: The customer shall be able to: View the Next button. Click the Next button. Continue to the next purchase step. The application shall prevent duplicate submissions when the button is clicked multiple times.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify Next button is interactable and initiates the next step in purchase journey
Verify Next button initiates the next step in purchase journey
Verify Next button behavior when clicked multiple times rapidly to prevent duplicate submissions
Verify Next button behavior when clicked multiple times rapidly to prevent duplicate submissions
traceability_matrix.reason: Test cases 659, 669, 664, and 674 fully validate AC4 by verifying Next button visibility, clickability, initiation of next purchase step, and prevention of duplicate submissions through rapid clicking scenarios with button disabling mechanisms.

traceability_matrix.acceptance_criterion: AC5 – User Authentication: If the customer is not authenticated, the application shall: Display the Login popup after clicking Next. Display Login and Sign Up options. Prevent the purchase journey until authentication is completed.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify login or sign-up popup is displayed with correct message and action buttons when unauthenticated user clicks Next
Verify login and sign-up popup displays with correct message and action buttons for unauthenticated user
Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains stable under timing-sensitive conditions
Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains functional across different viewport sizes
traceability_matrix.reason: Test cases 660, 670, 665, and 675 comprehensively validate AC5 by verifying that unauthenticated users see the login popup after clicking Next, confirming the popup displays correct message 'Please log in or create an account to continue with your purchase', verifying both 'Log in with Hub ID' and 'Don't have an account? Sign up here' buttons are present, and ensuring the purchase journey is blocked until authentication.

traceability_matrix.acceptance_criterion: AC6 – Error Handling: The application shall gracefully handle error scenarios including: Network interruption while loading pages. Device unavailability or out-of-stock condition. Slow network response while loading the Product Details Page. The application shall display appropriate messages without crashing.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify system behavior when user attempts to navigate to All Phones with network interruption
Verify system behavior when All Phones listing page fails to load or displays zero items
Verify system behavior when Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device is not available or out of stock on listing page
Verify error handling when Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device is unavailable or fails to load on listing page
Verify default configuration visibility and accuracy when PDP loads with delayed hydration or async rendering
Verify default configuration visibility and correctness when PDP loads with delayed hydration or slow network
traceability_matrix.reason: Test cases 661, 671, 662, 672, 663, and 673 fully validate AC6 by testing network interruption scenarios during page loading, device unavailability and out-of-stock conditions, slow network response handling on PDP, and verifying that appropriate error messages are displayed without application crashes.

traceability_matrix.acceptance_criterion: AC7 – Responsive Behaviour: The application shall ensure that the authentication popup: Displays correctly on Desktop. Displays correctly on Tablet. Displays correctly on Mobile. Maintains usability across supported screen resolutions.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains functional across different viewport sizes
traceability_matrix.reason: Test case 675 comprehensively validates AC7 by testing authentication popup display and functionality across mobile (375x667), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1920x1080) viewports, ensuring proper sizing, centering, readability, and usability across all supported screen resolutions.
